assign_vars_trace_execution_paths: assign explicit source and destination variables to bytecode instructions by tracing all execution paths
create_VarInstruction_with_src_dst_vars: create a VarInstruction wrapping a bytecode instruction with explicit source and destination variable lists
create_Var_with_num_and_type: create a Var object with a numeric identifier and optional type for variable tracking
fill_line_starts_on_var_instructions: fill in missing line start numbers on VarInstruction objects by propagating the last known line number
review_assign_vars_stack_simulation: review the assign_vars function that simulates stack state across execution paths to map implicit stack locations to explicit variables
